description: Where a person sits in the user's org chart, as Fluent infers it from the user's own calendar and meetings: who they probably report to, who reports to them, and who shares their manager. Each edge has a confidence, its evidence (a recurring 1:1, a staff meeting, a line someone said), and a status: "confirmed" when the user kept it, otherwise "inferred". Always say an inferred edge is inferred, never state it as fact. rosters lists the teams inside the user's company the person is on or leads: each with its name, its lead (leadId), its members, and a receipt for the team and for each membership (the recurring team meeting or the line that said it); a membership is "confirmed" when the user kept it, otherwise "suggested", which is a guess. betweenTeams lists the commitments and open questions the person owes or is owed across reporting lines (with someone who neither manages them, reports to them nor shares their manager), each with its source line; stalled ones say why (past due, quiet for two weeks, or raised again with no progress). Use personId "self" for the user, which lists every cross-team item.

personId.description: A person id from list_people, or "self"
